messages:
jamie_a: Heads up — HelixCorp exec escalated. They want the POC to start Wed but legal flagged BYOK/KMS + SOC2. Pricing thread stalled (they asked for a 40% POC discount). Need an exec-level unblock today. Who can own the bridge? @priya_se :eyes:
priya_se: On it. Quick clarifying Qs: what's our fastest realistic timeline for customer BYOK onboarding (HSM/KMS) for Private/Dedicated? Need to tell them 2–3 weeks vs 10+ days.
matt_infra: BYOK onboarding (customer KMS cert + attestation) requires an infra ticket + validation. Typical internal lead time ~10 business days after we get certs & signed agreement. Dedicated can be faster if we pre-approve certs in parallel — but still not same-day. cc @liam_sre for capacity/throughput risk.
liam_sre: Throughput note: POC expected burst ~1.2k qps, avg seq 512. For Dedicated we can meet that with 2xT4s per shard + autoscale config, but need confirmed concurrency profile. If they actually send that burst pattern on Wed it's tight. Recommend staged ramp.
sofia_ciso: Security checklist: HelixCorp asked for SOC2 snapshot, most recent pen test summary, and a data flow diagram. We can provide SOC2 attestation and pen-test executive summary. For BYOK we need a signed customer attestation + completed security questionnaire. I'll join exec bridge to confirm wording.
raj_security: They flagged 3 questionnaire items we couldn't answer in the first pass — key rotation frequency, HSM tenancy isolation, and logging/retention. Draft answers: ```Q9: keys rotated per customer policy; we support manual rotation + automated rotation hooks. Q14: BYOK supports HSM-backed keys; keys never leave HSM. Q22: all KMS ops logged to immutable audit trail for 1 year (extendable).``` Put these in the bridge deck.
jamie_a: Can we offer a short-term pricing unblock? They want 40% off for POC. I propose 25% + $10k credits for the 90-day POC to close the loop quickly. Any objections?
matt_infra: 25% + credits seems feasible on Hosted. If they insist on Dedicated for isolation, we need a minimum 3mo reserve or an engineering-approved trial commit. I'll run a cost delta for both options and post numbers in the bridge.
priya_se: Scheduling exec bridge at 16:30 PT today. @sofia_ciso @matt_infra @liam_sre please join. Jamie will lead. Agenda: 1) BYOK timeline, 2) SOC2/pen + questionnaire answers, 3) pricing offer + terms, 4) throughput mitigation plan.
ops-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled 16:30 PT — https://meet.redwood/helixcorp-bridge (calendar invite sent)
jamie_a: Quick final tactical Q before bridge — if BYOK can't be finished before POC kick, can we offer an isolated Dedicated instance (Redwood-managed keys) for the POC with a contractual commitment to migrate to BYOK when ready? I want to avoid killing the deal over timing.
sofia_ciso: Short-term isolated Dedicated with Redwood-managed keys is acceptable as a contingency, but legal must add a key-migration clause and we must get customer sign-off on data handling. I'll coordinate with Legal on language and join the bridge.
jamie_a: Great — will run bridge. TL;DR posted here after meeting. Current plan: bridge @16:30 PT, BYOK ~10bd if started today, provide SOC2 + pen summary, offer 25% + credits to unblock POC, contingency = isolated Dedicated + migration clause. Thanks team :pray:
